headings.usage: All section titles, hero headers, and modal titles. DO NOT use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Paragraphs, inputs, data tables, and small labels.

mono.usage: Code snippets, API keys, and technical metrics.

layouts.marketing_hero: Min-h-[80vh] flex flex-col justify-center relative overflow-hidden

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text is Slate-50 or Slate-200 on dark backgrounds. Avoid Slate-500 for body text.

media.illustrations: Abstract 3D shapes or geometric patterns. No cartoons.

3d_libraries.primary: Spline (via @splinetool/react-spline) for Hero elements if needed
3d_libraries.backgrounds: CSS Gradients + Noise Texture (no heavy WebGL unless necessary)

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js or .jsx extensions for all new files. The project is NOT TypeScript.
Implement the 'Sophisticated Gamification' theme: Dark backgrounds (#020617) with Neon Blue (#3b82f6) and Amber (#f59e0b) accents.
For the Landing Page, use the 'Tetris' grid layout. Do not stack everything in a single column.
For the Dashboard, use the 'Control Room' density. Avoid excessive whitespace between data points.
Use the provided image URLs for their respective sections. Do not use placeholders.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use 'Outfit' font for headings and 'Inter' for body. Add these to index.css or tailwind.config.js if missing.
Do not use generic gradients. Use the specified 'hero' and 'card_hover' gradients.
For the ROI Calculator, use a clean, card-based layout with slider inputs and real-time updating charts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
